capabilities: Export the current selection or whole note as RTF
Preserve headings, bold, italics, lists and tables
Strip Markdown links, wikilinks and visible URLs optionally
Choose an export folder or write beside the source note
Control list indentation and table width
extras: Desktop-only; the README notes it writes a local RTF file through Obsidian's adapter and that re-exporting overwrites the same target path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a passage or note to Word users in a format Word opens directly with formatting intact.
summary: Export plugin that converts the selected Markdown passage or whole note into a Word-readable RTF file, preserving headings, lists, tables and inline formatting.
